grid_recipe_filter.narration: Grid material filter: %s. Control + G to toggle.
grid_recipe_filter.tooltip.enabled:
Material filter: ON (Ctrl+G)
Only recipes using every material type in the crafting grid.
Ignores position and quantity. Click to show all recipes.
grid_recipe_filter.tooltip.disabled:
Material filter: OFF (Ctrl+G)
Click to filter recipes by the crafting grid materials.
grid_recipe_filter.configuration.enabled: Filter the vanilla crafting recipe book using input material types. Ignores position and quantity.
grid_recipe_filter.configuration.allCraf: Include locked and 3x3 recipes when the server also has this mod. Locked recipes are previews only.
grid_recipe_filter.catalog.full: Catalog: all crafting recipes, including locked recipes
grid_recipe_filter.requires_workbench: Requires a 3x3 crafting table. Open one to see all ingredients.
